'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Iraqi conflict]]
**Reports emerge that clashes between rival [[Shia]] militias, primarily [[Asa'ib Ahl al-Haq]] and [[Saraya al-Salam]], have killed at least 200 fighters across [[Iraq]] in the past two months. [https://themedialine.org/by-region/daily-clashes-between-iran-backed-militias-in-iraq-kill-over-200-fighters/ (''The Medialine'')]
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah clashes]]
**A Hezbollah missile fired at [[Shlomi, Israel]].[https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-it-carried-out-retaliatory-strikes-against-hezbollah-posts-in-southern-lebanon/ (Times of Israel)]
**Two civilians killed in [[Damascus]] of an Israeli airstrike at a Syrian security forces compound.[https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-state-media-says-several-israeli-missiles-hit-damascus-2024-02-21/ (Reuters)]
**Two civilians killed in Israeli airstrikes on [[Majdal Zoun]] with further airstrikes on Hezbollah outposts in [[Ramyeh]], [[Khaim]], [[Zibqin]] and with shelling of [[Aitaroun]].[https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-it-carried-out-retaliatory-strikes-against-hezbollah-posts-in-southern-lebanon/ (Times of Israel)][https://arab.news/vmh28 (Arab News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Lochem bridge collapse]]
**A [[bridge]] under construction in [[Lochem]], the Netherlands, collapses, killing two workers and injuring two others. [https://apnews.com/article/netherlands-bridge-collapse-deaths-176e3544e77a9da31605de834ee3d653 (AP)]
*[[2024 Sumedang tornado]]
**At least 33 people are injured after a tornado strikes {{ill|Rancaekek|id|Rancaekek, Bandung}}, [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-investigates-after-first-large-scale-tornado-strikes-2024-02-22/ (Reuters)]
*Fourteen people are killed and eleven more injured during the collapse of an illegal [[Mining|gold mine]] in [[Angostura Municipality, Bolívar|Angostura]], [[Venezuela]]. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-illegal-mine-collapse-31d40848d930906d1f592117058e71b7 (AP)]
*Fifteen people are killed and two survive when a truck falls off a cliff in [[Mabinay, Negros Oriental]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/15-killed-after-truck-falls-into-ravine-in-philippines-101708528136133.html (AFP via ''Hindustan Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[History of espionage|Espionage in the United States]]
**United States Navy [[chief petty officer]] Bryce Pedicini, assigned to the [[USS Higgins|USS ''Higgins'']], is charged with four counts of [[espionage]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-68366569 (BBC News)]
*[[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] calls for armed security patrols on streets and in workplaces, claiming the possibility of "extremist" crimes. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belarus-leader-lukashenko-calls-armed-street-patrols-warns-extremist-crime-2024-02-21/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Alabama Supreme Court|Supreme Court]] of the U.S. state of [[Alabama]] rules that frozen [[embryos]] in [[in-vitro fertilization|test tubes]] are legally considered [[children]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/02/20/health/ivf-alabama-abortion.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-68366337 (BBC News)]
